'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****At least five [[Palestinian]]s, including a child, are killed and several others are injured in [[Israel]]i strikes on the [[Jabalia refugee camp]] and the [[Shuja'iyya]] neighborhood of [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israel-kills-5-palestinians-including-child-in-attacks-on-gaza-strip/3318340 (Anadolu Agency)] [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20240902-israel-army-bombs-palestinians-buying-bread-near-shelter-centre-in-gaza-killing-5-injuring-several/ (Middle East Monitor)]
**[[2024 Tarqumiyah shooting]]
***Three [[Israel Police|Israeli police officers]] are killed in a [[drive-by shooting]] on a road near [[Tarqumiyah]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-817201 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Seven civilians injured in IDF strikes on Hezbollah targets in [[Aita al-Shaab]] and [[Beit Yahoun]], [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/2/israeli-war-on-gaza-live-israel-bombs-school-killing-11-palestinians (Al Jazeera)]
**Hezbollah launches 20 rockets on [[Upper Galilee]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/2/israeli-war-on-gaza-live-israel-bombs-school-killing-11-palestinians (Al Jazeera)]

*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukraine]] launches more than a hundred [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] against targets in [[Russia]], including the [[Konakovo Power Station]] in [[Konakovo]], [[Tver Oblast]], and the [[Moscow Refinery]] in [[Moscow]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-launches-drones-moscow-other-regions-russian-officials-say-2024-08-31/ (Reuters)]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***Russia reports that its forces have taken control of the settlements of [[Ptyche, Donetsk Oblast|Ptyche]] and [[Vyimka]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-it-has-captured-two-more-settlements-east-ukraine-2024-09-01/ (Reuters)]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***At least 47 people are injured when [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[missile]]s hit a shopping mall and events complex in [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-launches-mass-drone-attack-russia-loses-more-ground-east-2024-09-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement]]
**The office of the [[United Nations]] [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|High Commissioner for Human Rights]] announces that it will deploy a fact-finding team to investigate [[human rights]] abuses and violations committed by [[Fifth Hasina ministry|government]] forces during the quota reform movement, after being requested to do so by the [[Yunus interim government|interim government]] of [[Muhammad Yunus]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/08/30/bangladesh-yunus-hasina-turk-protests-human-rights/c0c5ecc8-66bc-11ef-a399-4245aabdb0ed_story.html (''The New York Times'')]

**The wreckage of the [[Russian Air Force]] [[Mil Mi-8T]] helicopter that [[plane crash|crashed]] on August 31 over the [[Russia|Russian]] [[Kamchatka Peninsula]] is located. '''Health and environment'''
*[[2024 Brazil wildfires]]
**The number of [[wildfire]]s in the [[Amazon rainforest]] reaches its highest number in fourteen years at 38,266 fire hotspots as a result of an ongoing [[2023–2024 South American drought|drought]] in [[South America]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazils-amazon-rainforest-fires-august-reach-14-year-high-2024-09-01/ (Reuters)]
*A [[weather station]] near [[Qeshm International Airport]] in [[Dayrestan]], [[Iran]], records the highest unverified [[heat index]] on Earth of {{conv|82.2|C}} and the highest [[dew point]] of {{conv|36.1|C}}. [[Climatologist]]s will investigate to confirm the readings' accuracy. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/iran-village-records-earths-highest-ever-heat-index-at-82-2c-what-does-this-mean/articleshow/112969326.cms?from=mdr (''The Economic Times'')] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/home/environment/iran-village-records-earths-highest-heat-index-at-82-2-c/articleshow/112944955.cms (''Times of India'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*Eleven people are killed and more than 40 others are injured when a [[truck crash]]es into a bar in [[Azua, Dominican Republic|Azua]], [[Dominican Republic]]. The driver subsequently flees the scene. [https://apnews.com/article/dominican-republic-crash-azua-killed-d671cda2b3c5b57ee6e185114516d2df (AP)]
*Two people are killed and four more injured during a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] outside a restaurant in [[Minneapolis]], [[Minnesota]], [[United States]]. The perpetrator's motive is unknown. [https://apnews.com/article/minnesota-fatal-restaurant-patio-crash-43f7244ee16546db176b4a95f2c20ae9 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[September 2024 Israel ceasefire protests]]
***Hundreds of thousands of [[Israelis]], including approximately 300,000 in [[Tel Aviv]], protest in cities across the country following the recovery of the bodies of six [[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|hostages]] from [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], with the [[Histadrut|national trade union center]] calling for a [[general strike]] on Monday and for [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] to [[resign]] after failing to negotiate a [[Three-phase Israel–Hamas war ceasefire proposal|ceasefire]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2024/09/01/world/israel-hamas-gaza-war (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-hostages-war-gaza-news-09-01-24/index.html (CNN)]
***At least 29 people are arrested in Tel Aviv on accusations of [[vandalism]], [[disorderly conduct]], and attacking police officers. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-hostages-war-gaza-news-09-01-24#h_f4c16c49d9170ad26bace26bb44fa7db (CNN)]
*[[2024 Saxony state election]], [[2024 Thuringian state election]]
**Parliamentary elections in the [[Germany|German]] states of [[Saxony]] and [[Thuringia]] show large gains for the right-wing [[populism|populist]] [[Alternative for Germany]] party and the left-wing populist [[Bündnis Sahra Wagenknecht]] party as well as losses for the left-wing and liberal parties of [[Scholz cabinet|the governing coalition]] and for the socialist [[The Left (Germany)|The Left]] party. In Thuringia, a [[Far-right politics in Germany (1945–present)|far-right]] party comes in first place in a state election for the first time since [[World War II]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-state-elections-who-won-who-lost-results-by-the-numbers/a-70105893 (DW)]
